title: Annealed Gibbs Measures with Data-Driven Interaction Potentials on Hierarchical Structures
abstract: arXiv:2606.30064v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: We construct annealed Gibbs measures on continuous interaction parameters and binary spins on Cayley trees of order $k\geq 1$, with coupling functions determined by an empirical loss. The interaction parameters and spins are distinct random variables: the former determine edge couplings, while the latter represent binary labels. The training data specify the coupling function and the joint Gibbs specification, rather than automatically selecting a unique Gibbs measure on interaction parameters.   We derive necessary and sufficient compatibility conditions for the finite-volume joint densities. These conditions take the form of nonlinear integral equations for boundary laws and characterize the splitting annealed Gibbs measures constructed here. translated_title: 层次结构上具有数据驱动相互作用势的退火吉布斯测度
translated_abstract: 我们在阶数 $k\geq 1$ 的Cayley树（凯莱树）上，针对连续的相互作用参数与二值自旋构造了退火吉布斯测度，其耦合函数由经验损失确定。相互作用参数与自旋是两类不同的随机变量：前者决定边上的耦合，后者表示二值标签。训练数据确定的是耦合函数与联合吉布斯规范，而非自动选出相互作用参数上唯一的吉布斯测度。我们推导了有限体积联合密度的充要相容性条件，这些条件表现为边界法则的非线性积分方程，并刻画了本文所构造的分裂退火吉布斯测度。对于 $k=1$，平移不变方程归结为正的紧积分算子，在所述假设下，这些方程具有唯一的归一化正解。对于 $k=2$，一个显式……（原文摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: 该论文在Cayley树上构造了由训练数据（经验损失）确定耦合函数的退火吉布斯测度，并推导出有限体积联合密度的充要相容性条件（即边界法则的非线性积分方程），证明了在 $k=1$ 时方程存在唯一的归一化正解。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs annealed Gibbs measures on Cayley trees with coupling functions determined by training data via empirical loss, and derives necessary and sufficient compatibility conditions for finite-volume joint densities in the form of nonlinear integral equations for boundary laws, proving a unique normalized positive solution for $k=1$.
